name: A Simple Love Story
source:
A young man named Michael happens to meet two of his classmates: Aceline and Emily, adding some spice to his mundane, everyday life.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=23284]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
一个名叫迈克尔的年轻人偶然遇到了他的两个同学：艾斯琳和艾米丽，为他平凡的日常生活增添了一些情趣。

[来自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=23284]引理软论坛[/url]]
